title: Our Baby Monitor Recorded Things That Hadn't Happened Yet #shorts #scarystories
description:
Every clip on the memory card was dated one day in the future.

Follow for new scary stories every day.

#scarystory #foundfootage #creepy #shorts

beats.text: This footage came off our baby monitor's memory card.
beats.card: NURSERY CAM SD CARD. RECOVERED NOV 2025. EVERY FILE IS DATED ONE DAY AHEAD.

beats.text: When our daughter Ivy was born, my wife Nora and I bought a cheap used baby monitor.
It saved every night to a little memory card.
The first week was normal. Ivy slept. We didn't.
Then one morning, I scrolled through the recordings.
At 3:12 AM, the crib was rocking. Slowly. By itself.
Nora said it was the heater. I wanted to believe her.
The next clip showed a dark shape standing by the crib.
But at 3:12 that night, Ivy wasn't even in there. Nora was feeding her in the kitchen.
Then I noticed the dates on the files.
beats.card: FILE 0047. RECORDED NOV 03, 3:12 AM. TODAY IS NOV 02.

beats.text: Every clip was dated one day ahead.
The monitor wasn't showing what happened. It showed what was going to happen.
At midnight, tomorrow's clip appeared.
The shape leaned over the crib and reached in.
So the next night, Ivy slept in our bed, and I waited in the nursery with a flashlight.
At 3:11, the room went ice cold.
At 3:12, the empty crib began to rock.
Something tall unfolded from the corner.
It bent over the crib, found it empty, and turned to me.
I hit the light switch. It was gone.
The woman who sold us the monitor finally called back.
She said it only shows you what's coming, so you have one day to move your baby.
Her family had learned that too late.
beats.card: SELLER'S NOTE: KEEP IT RECORDING. IT ONLY COMES WHERE THE BABY SHOULD BE.

beats.text: Ivy is safe. She sleeps between us every night now.
But this morning, a new file loaded. It's dated tomorrow.
It shows our bedroom, and something standing at the foot of our bed.
